content.title: C.H. Robinson (CHRW): Margin Recovery Challenges Views on Sustainability After Years of Earnings Decline
content.summary: C.H. Robinson Worldwide (CHRW) posted a 4.5% annual revenue growth forecast, lagging behind the broader US market’s 10.3% expectation. EPS is projected to rise 7.57% per year, also slower than the market’s 15.7%. The company’s net profit margin improved to 3.1% from 1.9% last year, and recent annual earnings growth jumped 60.9%, standing out against a longer-term average annual decline of 11.5%. content.summary: Shares of companies in the tech sector led the decline in the wake of quarterly earnings from Meta Platforms and Microsoft.  Meta Platforms  missed analysts’ third-quarter earnings expectations and the stock declined 11%.  Meta said the earnings miss included a one-time tax charge of $15.93 billion from the implementation of the Trump administration’s One Big Beautiful Bill Act.
